statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of these transient loss-of-consciousness events
The service is to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The denial reason is Reason Code CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
